patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Rank Prompt and Turbotic share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Rank Prompt only if your buying job matches “AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI category.” rather than Turbotic's shape. Choose Turbotic only if your buying job matches “Automation AI platform — Free tier; Basic from $14.99/mo annual; Pro from $79.99/mo annual” rather than Rank Prompt's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Rank Prompt is shaped for AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI cat whereas Turbotic is shaped for Automation AI platform — Free tier; Basic from $14.99/mo annual; Pro f. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Rank Prompt and Turbotic share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

- Researched limits: Rank Prompt — GEO/AEO niche — not general-purpose AI writing; Turbotic — Newer platform — confirm enterprise references and connector catalog depth.
